newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania prosecutors say 149 in detention.
newsitem.headline: Albania prosecutors say 149 in detention.

text.p: Albanian authorities, seeking to quell a nationwide surge of unrest, have arrested 149 people and charged them with violence, theft and damaging public property, deputy prosecutor-general Gani Dizdari said on Thursday.

Thousands of desperate investors fearing the loss of all their money in collapsed pyramid schemes staged protests last weekend, torching government buildings in the southern towns of Berat, Lushnje, Fieri and Vlore.

"Through the material evidence and facts we possess, those charged are accused of violent acts against property through theft and destruction, aiming to disrupt public order," Dizdari said in a statement.
"On these findings, prosecutors have ordered the detention and arrest of 149 persons," he added.
Those detained could face at least 15 years in jail if convicted, the statement said.

The prosector's office had asked Albania's highest court, the Court of Cassation, to transfer all the cases from Berat, Lushnje and Fieri to Tirana district court because protesters had burned down court buildings in those towns.
Civil cases would also be brought against those convicted of destroying the buildings to force those responsible to pay the costs of the damage, the statement said.
